concept: CUR: the most granular billing data for Athena
tests: Choosing the tool with hourly, resource-level billing lines for custom SQL queries and chargeback.
expected: AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) — line-item data in S3, queried via Athena/Redshift/QuickSight. Triggers: "most granular", "hourly, resource-level", "custom SQL in Athena", "chargeback by business unit".
why_not: Budgets — thresholds and alerts; Cost Explorer — interactive visualization without SQL access to line items; Trusted Advisor — best-practice checks, not billing.
